resources.string: UdyamSetu chhoti dukaan ke liye free GST billing hai — koi paywall nahi, koi ads nahi, aapka data aapke phone par hi rehta hai.
Ye kaam browser me nahi ho sakta — inke liye Android app (APK) chahiye. Baaki sab kuch is site par hi hai.
Bill mein kuch galat hai — check karein.
GST jodein (rashi me GST nahi hai)
Rashi aur GST rate bharein — calculator GST aur total dikhayega. Koi data save nahi hota.
Draft save ho gaya ✓ (number abhi nahi laga)
Drive backup fail ho gaya — dobara try karein.

Google sign-in abhi offline hai — backup ke liye ek baar internet chahiye.
Restore ke liye yehi passphrase chahiye. Ye kahin save nahi hoti.

UdyamSetu — free, offline, aapka data aapke phone par hi rehta hai.
3 chhote sawaal — setup aapke hisaab se
GSTIN galat hai — 15 character, sahi format mein likhein.

GST Bharat me samaan aur sevaon ki bikri par lagne wala tax hai. Kharidne aur bechne wala ek hi rajya me ho to bill me CGST + SGST dikhta hai. Alag rajya ho to IGST dikhta hai. Rate item par depend karta hai — uska HSN code check karein.

Is app me GST rates: 0%%, 5%%, 12%%, 18%% aur 28%% (sone jaise khaas items ke liye 0.1%%, 0.25%%, 1.5%% aur 3%% bhi hain). Roz ke khane ki cheezein aksar 0%% ya 5%% hoti hain; aam samaan 12%% ya 18%% hota hai. Sahi rate item ke HSN code se milta hai — doubt ho to apne CA se poochhein.

GSTR-1 me mahine ki bikri (outward supplies) likhi hoti hai. GSTR-3B mahine ka summary hai — kul bikri, kul tax, aur jo tax aapko dena hai. Dono GST portal par file hote hain; ye app sirf draft report banata hai. Due dates badalti rehti hain — is mahine ki dates ke liye hamesha GST portal check karein.

e-Invoice matlab B2B bill ko portal se IRN (Invoice Reference Number) milta hai, QR code ke saath. e-Way Bill samaan ek jagah se dusri jagah le jaane ke liye chahiye. Dono sirf kuch turnover limit ke upar lagte hain — bharosa karne se pehle GST portal par current limit check karein.
GSTR-9 saalana return hai — poore financial year ka summary. Saal ka turnover Rs 2 crore se zyada ho to ye mandatory hota hai. Turnover isse kam ho to portal check karein — niyam badal sakta hai.

Aam galtiyan: (1) bill par galat GSTIN, (2) galat rajya — inter-state sale par CGST + SGST dikhana, ya intra-state sale par IGST, (3) portal par GSTR-2B check kiye bina ITC lena, (4) is app ki draft report ko filed return samajhna — filing sirf GST portal par hoti hai, (5) credit note ko aam bill ki tarah save karna.
Chhote, saral facts. Filing aur due dates ke liye hamesha GST portal check karein.
1. Setup me dukaan ka naam bharein
2. Party chunein ya nayi party jodein
3. Item jodein, preview dekhein, bill save karein
Ye reports DRAFT hain — portal pe upload karke verify karein. App filing nahi karta; ITC aap portal 2B se bharein.
Customer / supplier jodein, udhaar likhein, payment lein. Positive balance = party ko dena hai (lena hai); negative = humko dena hai.
PF/ESI/PT/TDS rates aap + CA se confirm karke bharein — app koi statutory rate assume nahi karta (default 0).
Tally CSV BETA hai — CA pilot pending, \"CA-ready\" nahi hai. Export se pehle CA se confirm karein.
Item jodein, stock badhayein/ghataayein, batch + expiry track karein. Bill save hote hi stock apne aap ghatega (jo item HSN/naam se milega).
Udhaar yaad rahega, GST report ban jayega — sab kuch free, aapke phone par.
English default hai. Aap apni bhasha chunein.
Bill par tap karein — dekhein, print karein, WhatsApp par bhejein.
Abhi koi bill nahi hai. Pehla bill \"Naya Bill\" se banayein.
Credit Note = wapas / kami (negative). Debit Note = extra charge (positive). Dono purane bill se judte hain.
Ek baar bhar dein — har bill par yehi details aayengi. Badal bhi sakte hain.
Kuch galat hai — laal wale field check karein.
